Read a user-uploaded shapefile folder

Source: R/5_mapping_get_mapping_data.R
read_shapefile_folder.Rd

Reads a shapefile from the files of an uploaded folder, as a Shiny multi-file or folder fileInput() gives them: a data frame with each file's original name and the datapath it was saved to. The .shp, .dbf, .shx and .prj files are all required; they are copied under their original names into one temporary directory and read from there. Other files are ignored.

Usage

read_shapefile_folder(files_df, call = caller_env())

Arguments

files_df

A data frame with name and datapath columns, one row per uploaded file.

call

The calling environment, forwarded to cd_abort().

Value

The uploaded shapefile as a valid sf object, reprojected to EPSG:4326. Column names are exactly as uploaded: the column holding the unit names is not renamed to NAME_1.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a Shiny server, for fileInput("shapefile", "Shapefile", multiple = TRUE) in the page
boundaries <- read_shapefile_folder(input$shapefile)

# outside Shiny: the parts of a shapefile kept in one folder
parts <- list.files("boundaries", full.names = TRUE)
boundaries <- read_shapefile_folder(data.frame(name = basename(parts), datapath = parts))
names(boundaries)
} # }
